data.name: Super Woden GP 3
data.detailed_description:
Can you reach the top of the motorsport world?

Your journey in Super Woden GP 3 begins with a modest budget and one goal: become a motorsport legend. Buy your first car, enter competitions, earn credits, expand your garage, and work your way to the top by taking on the world's best drivers.

Enjoy a massive Career Mode featuring a wide variety of disciplines, including championships, rally events, circuit racing, endurance races, special events, and much more.

■ Explore an intuitive world map that gives you access to dealerships, competitions, workshops, and many other activities.

■ Collect a huge variety of vehicles from manufacturers around the world, ranging from compact city cars and classic sports cars to rally machines, GT cars, prototypes, and much more.

■ Fully customize your vehicles in the workshop: repaint them, install performance upgrades, and fine-tune them for every competition.

■ Expand your collection by unlocking hidden and exclusive vehicles as you progress.

■ Race through a wide variety of locations, including cities, mountains, deserts, forests, snowy landscapes, and many other environments inspired by real-world locations.

■ A vibrant comic-inspired art style, enhanced by multiple viewing modes that deliver a unique visual experience.

■ Compete with friends in local split-screen multiplayer for up to four players.

data.short_description: Experience the ultimate arcade driving experience! Journey through motorsport history by collecting vehicles from every era and compete in rally, circuit racing, endurance racing, and many other disciplines as you climb to the top of motorsport in an extensive campaign mode.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1050Ti or higher or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent

  • Graphics: 1060Ti or AMD Equivalent
